- **Check the agent is registered.** Recruiting agents for jobs abroad must be registered with the Government of India. Ask for the registration number and check it on the official eMigrate portal, emigrate.gov.in.
- **Read the contract before paying anything.** A real employer gives you a written contract with salary, hours and the employer’s name.
- **Never pay into a personal bank account or UPI ID.** Real companies take payment through their own website or a licensed payment gateway, and give you a receipt.
- **Be careful with "too good" offers.** Very high salaries for little experience, no interview, or pressure to pay today are warning signs.
- **Talk to your family.** Fraudsters rush people. Take your time.
